note: Flux-integrated differential cross section per unit neutrino energy, dσ/dE ≈ σ(E)/E, for muon-neutrino CC-inclusive and muon-antineutrino CC-inclusive interactions vs true neutrino energy E_nu (2-22 GeV), measured with the MINERvA scintillator-tracker in the low-energy NuMI beam (FHC = neutrino mode, RHC = antineutrino mode). The paper also reports the antineutrino/neutrino cross-section ratio R(E) — a dimensionless ratio, not a cross section, so it was excluded from the ingested items per instructions. Target: per nucleon (isoscalar-corrected carbon; MINERvA's scintillator-tracker fiducial volume is 88.5% carbon by mass, and the paper explicitly states results are corrected to and reported "on a carbon target", isoscalar-corrected — see abstract line 143-144 and body text lines 279-281, 616, 630-638, 695-698 of ratio_paper.tex).
